description: Use this when the user wants printable raffle tickets, a raffle ticket template, or numbered tickets with stubs for a fundraiser. Returns a print-ready PDF with 10 or 8 numbered tickets per US Letter or A4 sheet, each with a stub carrying the same number, dashed cut lines, and the event name, date, prizes, price and contact line; numbers run in order across sheets with no gaps or repeats. Up to 2,000 tickets per call. Does not sell tickets, collect payments or check whether a raffle is legal where the user lives.

color.description: Accent colour as a name or hex, e.g. blue, green or #1D5FC4. Default red.

contact.description: Organizer contact line, e.g. PTA - pta@example.org - (555) 010-2000.

count.description: How many tickets, 1 to 2,000. Default 100. Example: 200.

date.description: Draw date and time as you want it printed, e.g. May 3, 2027 at 7 pm or 2027-05-03.

digits.description: Minimum digits per number with leading zeros, e.g. 4 gives 0001. Default 4.

end_number.description: Last ticket number instead of count, e.g. 500 for tickets 1 to 500.

event_name.description: Event or fundraiser name printed on each ticket, e.g. Spring Gala Raffle. Default: Raffle.

fine_print.description: Short line such as Need not be present to win.

location.description: Where the draw happens, e.g. Lincoln High School gym.

per_page.description: Tickets per sheet: 10 (2 x 5, each 3.75 x 2 in) or 8 (2 x 4, each 3.75 x 2.5 in). Default 10.

prefix.description: Text before each number, e.g. A- gives A-0001. Default none.

price.description: Ticket price as printed, e.g. 5 (printed $5), "$5 or 5 for $20", or "€2".

prizes.description: Prize lines, up to 3 printed, e.g. ["Grand prize: 55-inch TV", "2nd: $100 gift card"] or one line.

stub_fields.description: Write-in lines on the stub, up to 3. Default Name and Phone. Example: Name, Phone, Email.

name: generate_raffle_tickets
title: Generate raffle tickets
